test_title: RRB Technician Grade III Official Paper (Held On: 26 Dec, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Which of the following is/are correct with regard to the technique of plants to get rid of waste material?

A. Plants get rid of excess water by transpiration.

B. Waste products may be stored in leaves that fall off.

C. Waste products are stored as resins and gums, especially in old xylem.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Option 2**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• Plants get rid of excess water by the process of **transpiration**. This involves the evaporation of water from the plant's surface, primarily through stomata.
 
• **Waste products** may be stored in the leaves, which eventually fall off. This is a method plants use to remove harmful substances.
 
• Plants also store waste products as **resins and gums**, often accumulating in the old xylem tissues.
 
• These processes help the plant maintain its metabolic balance and avoid damage from toxic substances.
 
• Another method includes the storage of waste in vacuoles within plant cells, which helps isolate harmful substances.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Transpiration**

 
 
• It is the process of water movement through a plant and its evaporation from aerial parts, like leaves, stems, and flowers.
 
• Transpiration serves to cool plants and enables the flow of nutrients and water from roots to shoots.
 
 
 
• **Resins and Gums**
 
 
• Resins are complex organic substances produced by many plants, particularly conifers, and are typically exuded in response to injury.
 
• Gums are polysaccharides that are soluble in water and are produced by many plants, often in response to wounding.
 
 
 
• **Vacuoles**
 
 
• Vacuoles are membrane-bound organelles in plant cells that store nutrients and waste products.
 
• They play a significant role in maintaining the osmotic balance within the cell.
 
 
 
• **Leaf Abscission**
 
 
• Leaf abscission is the process by which leaves detach from a plant.
 
• This process helps plants to shed leaves that store waste products, thus removing harmful substances from the plant system.
